title: Support thread on retention
caption: A chat thread changes the policy: 90 days on Enterprise, 30 on every other plan.
verdict: A short chat thread changes a policy: from 1 May, Enterprise exports are kept for 90 days and every other plan stays at 30. The agent replaces the single 30-day claim with one claim per plan.
lesson: Decisions often arrive in chat, not in documents. Filing them on the policy page means the next reader finds them without knowing the thread exists.

quotes: The lifecycle rule on exports-prod will read a plan tag, so nothing changes for files that already exist.
anchors: From 1 May 2026 the period depends on the plan

quotes: From 1 May, export files for Enterprise plans are kept for 90 days. All other plans stay at 30 days.

lede: A short chat thread arrives. A decision made in chat changes the retention policy.
key: From 1 May, export files for Enterprise plans are kept for 90 days. All other plans stay at 30 days.
did: Marked the single 30-day value as outdated.
Wrote two values in its place, 30 days for most plans and 90 days for Enterprise, both credited to this thread.
Noted on Rui's page that he will update the help-centre FAQ.
